# `/implement`

> Implement the next pending task. Auto-detects the feature if no argument given.

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/implement.md — do not edit -->

Implements the next pending task in your own context (manual mode).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/implement [feature-name]` |
| **Reads** | `tasks.md`, `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `DESIGN.md`, sources |
| **Writes** | code; ticks the task in `tasks.md` |
| **Gates** | Stops if a design component is missing from the inventory; honors the task's `Files` scope; one task per call. |
| **Next** | `/implement` again, then `/review` |
| **Tools** | `Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob` |
